ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AAA Technologies Limited announced a significant board overhaul, with the Managing Director and Chairman, Mr. Venugopal Dhoot, resigning due to a change in company ownership/control via a Share Purchase Agreement. This material leadership transition is further compounded by the resignation of an Independent Director, while two new directors (one executive, one independent) have been appointed, leading to a comprehensive reconstitution of key board committees. The document indicates a substantial shift in company leadership and potential strategic direction following the undisclosed change in ownership.
